prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Jason D’s Vision location master source, wide landscape, later cropped to 16:9 and centered 4:5.
Primary request: An original photorealistic artistic interpretation of the Basílica de Nuestra Señora del Pilar, Zaragoza, at 22:33 Europe/Madrid on 23 September 2026, from the public Balcón de San Lázaro on the north bank near 41.6582,-0.8741, eye level looking southwest across the Ebro and Puente de Piedra. It is Night. Open-Meteo model valid 22:30: overcast, 24.6°C, WMO 3, 77% cloud, no precipitation, 2.7 km/h wind; model data, not an on-site observation. Sun below horizon at elevation -28.31°, azimuth 298.84°; no direct sunlight.
Scene/backdrop: The Ebro and a low shadowed vegetated near bank fill the foreground. Puente de Piedra crosses diagonally across the central midground with several broad stone arches and small restrained lamps. Immediately behind on the south bank, the Basilica forms its recognizable LONG horizontal Baroque mass with FOUR tall slender corner towers, one dominant central dome and several smaller colorful tiled domes; preserve the real hierarchy rather than multiplying towers.
Composition/framing: Distant public-bank panorama, not aerial. The entire principal bridge/basilica group occupies only the central 45% of the wide canvas, centered as one ensemble, with both outer basilica towers and the relevant bridge arches fully retained for a centered portrait crop. Ample overcast sky and river foreground; realistic city scale.
Lighting/mood: Heavy broken overcast night with no moon or stars. Historically documented warm illumination may outline the basilica and bridge, but tonight’s lighting schedule is unverified; keep the glow restrained, clouds dimly visible and reflections short/subtle on gently moving water. No rain and no glossy promenade.
Constraints: Accurate Zaragoza skyline; four main basilica towers, not six or eight; no Gothic cathedral spires, no fantasy palace, no modern bridge substituted, no boats as focal points, no crowds, logos, readable signs or fireworks. No text, caption, signature, border or watermark.

architectural_anchors: Puente de Piedra crosses diagonally through the foreground/midground with several broad stone arches and restrained lamps
The basilica forms a long riverside Baroque mass with four tall corner towers and a dominant central dome plus smaller tiled domes
Ebro water and a low vegetated bank occupy the foreground; cathedral and bridge remain together in the central composition
